title: Agro Planner Update (v1.0.4)
releaseNotes:
- Practical Commercial Broiler Lifecycle: 12-stage management schedule from Day 1 to Day 42 (Starter Crumbles, 3-day feed transitions, Grower, Finisher, and Harvest).
- Checkpoint Reminders & Organisation Broadcast: Deterministic 07:00 AM reminder dispatches with animal telemetry and live status alerts sent to all members.
- Move-in Date Tracking: Exact arrival date entry for existing and new livestock with real-time countdown to target sale.
- IBD Protocol Update: Updated nomenclature across all vaccine protocols and seed records.
